about: Fixture corpus for the three-lane decisor. The decisor is prose and judgement — chosen deliberately over deterministic signals — so this corpus is the mechanism that makes it checkable (P2). Scored by the behaviour eval, not by npm test; what npm test checks is that the corpus stays honest: every lane represented, every case reasoned, and the cases this lane exists because of still present.

lanes.answer: information only; writes nothing, creates no artifact
lanes.ftd: authorised change, ordinary; one feature document
lanes.sdd: the ten-phase chain, by explicit request or accepted proposal only

cases.request: ¿Por qué el login tarda tanto en producción?

cases.why: comparison and a recommendation are information, not a mandate

cases.request: Revisa este diff y dime si tiene bugs
cases.why: review is read-only even though it is about code that changes

cases.request: Audita la seguridad de la capa de autenticación
cases.why: audit; a finding is not permission to fix it
thinking aloud about a feature is not a request to build it; ask before building
